decisions.question: Which one should the card title use?
decisions.context:
Which error tracking service should we wire into the web app? Sentry is free to 5k errors/month, then $26/month, and includes session replay. GlitchTip is free and self-hosted on our VPS, but we patch and back it up ourselves (about an hour a month). Which one should we use? Which one should the card title use?

- Sentry (Recommended): Hosted, no ops work. Free up to 5k errors/month, then $26/month. Session replay included.
- Self-hosted GlitchTip: Free, runs on our VPS. We handle patching and backups, about an hour a month.
